title: Cisco readies new control plane for quantum networks
key_facts: Cisco's prototype Quantum Network Controller is designed to coordinate quantum computers, memories and switches on one network
Described in a blog post by Vijoy Pandey, SVP and GM of Outshift by Cisco
Pandey: connecting 1,000 quantum nodes point to point takes close to 500,000 dedicated links
Applications would request entanglement by naming endpoints, rate, fidelity and timing; Cisco calls this Entanglement-as-a-Service
Controller uses Cisco's Universal Quantum Switch announced earlier this year, which Cisco says connects systems from vendors such as IBM, IonQ, Google and Rigetti
A new prototype of Cisco's Network-Aware Quantum Compiler works with the controller and adds a distributed error-correction package
Cisco's own team calls the controller a research prototype
quote_evidence: Cisco's Quantum Network Controller is a research prototype exploring what that operational layer could look like, wrote Reza Nejabati and Sabitha Krishnamurthy.
The Controller keeps checking that the link stays healthy for as long as the application is using it, wrote Pandey.
why_it_matters_hint: Software to run a network of quantum machines is a missing piece, but Cisco itself calls this a prototype.
notes: Cisco's claims are relayed by Network World from Cisco blog posts.
